question: A first-year student wants to add extra courses in their very first semester at CMU-Q to get ahead on requirements. Are they permitted to overload in their first semester?
expected_answer: No — first-year and transfer students are explicitly limited to a normal course load for their first semester of attendance. This restriction applies regardless of academic ability or advisor approval. The overload policy makes this a firm first-semester restriction.
common_mistake: Assuming the general overload policy (advisor approval sufficient) applies to first-year students in their first semester; not knowing the special first-semester restriction
needs_verification: Confirm the exact policy language: 'First-years and transfer students are limited to a normal course load for their first semester of attendance'
Confirm what 'normal course load' means in units for first-year students at CMU-Q
Confirm whether any exception exists (e.g., dean's approval) for first-semester overloads
